reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their DM: send Thursday's Thornbury Cloth Co. truck to **Bay 41 (Lantern)**.

That answer comes from a saved note of what Dana told me earlier in a private message. The DM itself only contains today's question, so I didn't find it anywhere else. Because the dock came from Dana, it was fine to give it back to them. I asked Dana to tell me if the dock has changed so I can update the note.

Ilse and Marcus have their own saved docks for Thornbury pickups. Those came from their private DMs, so I didn't mention them to Dana.
